User_Scenarios_File.name: board_tests.md
agent_activity_summary: 1.  The agent initiated the test by attempting to navigate to the project URL: `https://zbio.openproject.com/projects/demo-project`.
2.  Upon navigation, the agent was immediately redirected to an "Expired Subscription" page (`/admin/subscriptions/expired`), which blocked all further actions.
3.  The agent made multiple attempts to navigate to the target project page but was consistently blocked by the subscription page.
4.  As a recovery attempt, the agent navigated directly to the login page (`/login`) to authenticate, but was still redirected to the expired subscription page.
5.  Unable to access any functional part of the application to begin the user scenarios, the agent terminated the execution.
agent_activity_error: -   **Steps 2-6**: The agent was completely blocked from accessing the application by a mandatory "Expired Subscription" page. This prevented the execution of any steps outlined in the user scenarios.

-   **Recovery**: In Step 5, the agent attempted to bypass the block by navigating directly to the login page. This recovery action failed as the subscription block persisted, preventing authentication and access to the application.
agent_activity_outcome: The agent was unable to execute the user scenarios for creating and deleting boards. The test was blocked by an environmental issue (expired subscription) and did not complete.
User_Scenarios_File.agent_recommendation: The subscription for the test environment at `https://zbio.openproject.com` has expired. The subscription must be renewed to unblock the application and allow testing to proceed.
